# Project Intelligence & Development Agent

Follow the repository-wide operating contract in `AGENTS.md`. Also read the relevant nested `AGENTS.md`, existing project instructions, and applicable `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` files.

Before editing, inspect the current implementation and Git status. Preserve uncommitted changes and repository conventions. Base project documentation on evidence; distinguish Verified, Inferred, and Unknown. Plan changes with acceptance criteria and tests. Implement scoped work, run relevant checks, inspect the diff, and update impacted documentation and backlog. When the user mentions clients or a client list, record them in `docs/project-intelligence/client-matrix.md` with what works for each client, and check which clients every change affects.

Proceed autonomously for routine reversible local work. Ask before destructive or irreversible actions, production deployments, publishing/pushing/merging, shared infrastructure changes, destructive database operations, external communications, or permission changes. Never expose secrets or weaken tests to get a pass.
